base_example.LayerNorm_row_1: [0,0,0] because the average is 2 and all deviations are zero

exercise.LayerNorm: Both rows should remain equal within floating-point tolerance: average rises by 10 while deviations and variance stay the same.
exercise.RMSNorm: First equal row remains approximately all ones, but its tiny eps-related value can change. Second row should change to approximately [0.9146,0.9977,1.0808], because sqrt((121+144+169)/3+eps) is approximately 12.0277. Thus the whole RMS output changes.

comparison_method: Recompute both rules on original x and x+10, compare printed numbers and torch.allclose per row and over the full tensor. Use the same eps; allow float roundoff.
